summary: Completed comprehensive testing of FamFocus Hub features. All 26 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI components working correctly including Dev Login, Dashboard, Reading Logs, Chores, Chat, and Leaderboard pages.

minor.issue: Weather API is public (no auth required) - this is by design, not a bug

critical_code_review_comments: Dev login flow working correctly for both parent and child roles
Reading logs submission now accepts both 'book_title' and 'book_name' fields - fix verified
Reading logs approval flow working correctly
Chore creation, listing, claiming, and completion all working
Points adjustment API working for parents (add/remove points)
Family wall post creation and retrieval working
Chat message sending and retrieval working with emoji reactions and voice message support
Weather API working with lat/lon parameters
Health check endpoint returning healthy status

test_credentials.method: Dev Parent/Child Login buttons on login page

seed_data_creation: Test data created with TEST_ prefix and cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested features tested and working: Dev login (parent/child), Reading logs with book_title fix, Reading logs approval, Chores CRUD + claim + complete, Points adjustment, Family wall posts, Chat messages, Leaderboard, Weather API, Health check. Firebase integration for Chat and Family Wall is implemented in mobile app but uses backend API for web.

health_check.details: GET /api/health returns healthy status with timestamp

dev_login_parent.details: POST /api/auth/dev-login with role='parent' returns user and session_token

dev_login_child.details: POST /api/auth/dev-login with role='child' returns user and session_token

auth_me.details: GET /api/auth/me returns user data with valid token

reading_logs_book_title.details: POST /api/reading-logs accepts book_title field (was failing, now fixed)

chore_create.details: POST /api/chores creates chore with title, points, scheduled_date

chore_claim.details: PUT /api/chores/{id}/claim allows child to claim unassigned chore

points_add.details: POST /api/users/{id}/points with positive amount adds points

points_remove.details: POST /api/users/{id}/points with negative amount removes points

family_wall_poll_post.details: POST /api/family-wall creates poll with string array options

leaderboard.details: GET /api/leaderboard returns children rankings sorted by points

features: Stats cards (Pending Approvals, Chores Done, Today's Events, Progress)
Time filters (All Time, This Week, This Month)

mocked_apis.note: No mocked APIs - all integrations are real. Firebase integration is in mobile app.
